text:
Hi everyone! 😊

Does anyone here live in Kiryat Ono? My partner and I have just moved here, and we’d love to get to know more people in the area.

A little about us: we’re a same-sex couple with a baby boy and two dogs 🐶. We love checking out coffee carts and exploring national parks. We’d love to meet other couples for a coffee. Feel free to send me a message! ☕️
